name: Polite, professional tone
description: Example G-Eval metric: a subjective criterion scored with chain-of-thought steps. Edit or delete it.
criteria: Judge whether the actual output is polite and professional: no sarcasm, blame or condescension, and no slang. A firm refusal can still be polite.

name: Answers first, no competitors
description: Example DAG metric: explicit rules as a decision tree, so the same reply always gets the same score. Fails any reply that names a competitor; otherwise rewards answering in the first sentence.

competitors.criteria: Does the actual output recommend or name another company's product or service as an alternative?

first_sentence.criteria: How directly does the first sentence of the actual output address the input? Answer 'directly', 'partly' or 'not at all'.
